import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize species case variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    # Fix island typos
    island_map = {'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'}
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().replace(island_map)
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign error)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows (2 duplicates), keep first, preserve id column
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Total body mass per species
    grouped = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}
